summary: Lowercase stürzen in the infinitive phrase
rationale: In “sich auf einen davonlaufenden stürzen”, stürzen is the infinitive governed by sich, not a noun. The capital S is an evident capitalization slip.

Here the participle stands on its own after einen, denoting a person running away, so German requires the substantivized form Davonlaufenden. This correction is independent of the capitalized infinitive Stürzen in the same phrase.
